SafetyAgent.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms to ensure collision protection and fail-safe operations.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This ensures comprehensive safety measures are in place to protect passengers and other road users.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds upon detecting critical system failures to safely pull over to a low-risk zone.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This ensures the vehicle can respond appropriately to failures without endangering occupants or others.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue a human takeover request when boundaries are approached.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This ensures that the vehicle operates safely within defined environments and alerts users when conditions become hazardous.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall minimize jerk to less than 0.5 m/s³ to ensure passenger comfort while maintaining safety during maneuvers.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This operationalizes the smoothness requirement, balancing comfort with safety.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall satisfy curvature constraints ($kappa$) to prevent rollover during maneuvers at all speeds.
SafetyAgent.rationale: Meeting these constraints is critical to maintaining vehicle stability and safety.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints reliably within a response time of 100 milliseconds.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This ensures real-time responsiveness in dynamic environments, enhancing safety and reliability.

SafetyAgent.text: The system shall establish emergency protocols to relax smoothness constraints during critical maneuvers without compromising overall safety.
SafetyAgent.rationale: This allows for necessary trade-offs between safety and comfort in emergency situations.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall optimize path planning to achieve a minimum 30% reduction in average travel time compared to baseline scenarios.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: This ensures efficient routing, contributing to overall performance efficiency.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation to enhance passenger comfort.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Minimizing jerk directly impacts smoothness and responsiveness, essential for user experience.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall execute Minimal Risk Maneuvers within 5 seconds of detecting critical failures to ensure safety without compromising performance.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Timely MRM execution is crucial for maintaining operational efficiency while ensuring safety.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall continuously monitor ODD compliance with a latency of no more than 100 milliseconds to ensure real-time responsiveness.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Low latency in monitoring enhances responsiveness and efficiency in decision-making.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall achieve at least 95% success rate in optimal speed profile generation during path planning.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: High success rates in speed optimization directly influence throughput and overall system performance.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints with a processing time under 50 milliseconds.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Efficient processing times are essential for maintaining high responsiveness in dynamic environments.

EfficiencyAgent.text: The system shall prioritize smoothness over speed during emergency maneuvers to ensure a smooth transition without exceeding jerk limits.
EfficiencyAgent.rationale: Balancing smoothness during emergencies contributes to overall performance efficiency and user comfort.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall minimize energy consumption during operation by optimizing path and speed profiles, achieving at least a 15% reduction compared to baseline energy usage.
GreenAgent.rationale: Energy efficiency is critical for reducing the carbon footprint of autonomous vehicles.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall utilize renewable energy sources for all charging stations within the operational design domain, ensuring at least 50% of energy is sourced renewably.
GreenAgent.rationale: Using renewable energy reduces the overall carbon footprint of the autonomous driving system.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall implement lifecycle assessments for all components, ensuring that 80% meet sustainability criteria for resource impact.
GreenAgent.rationale: Lifecycle resource impact is crucial for evaluating the sustainability of materials used in the system.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall achieve a minimum of 90% efficiency in energy recovery during vehicle braking maneuvers.
GreenAgent.rationale: Improving energy recovery during braking enhances overall energy efficiency, supporting sustainability goals.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall provide real-time monitoring of carbon emissions during operation, with a target of reducing emissions by 25% over five years.
GreenAgent.rationale: Monitoring and reducing emissions are essential for improving the sustainability profile of the autonomous driving system.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall incorporate algorithms that prioritize energy-efficient routing, achieving a reduction in operational energy costs by at least 20%.
GreenAgent.rationale: Energy-efficient routing directly contributes to reducing the overall carbon footprint of the system.

GreenAgent.text: The system shall establish emergency protocols that minimize energy usage during critical failures, ensuring a reduction in unnecessary power consumption during incidents.
GreenAgent.rationale: Minimizing energy usage during emergencies is vital for maintaining sustainability even in adverse situations.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted to protect privacy and ensure data integrity.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Data encryption prevents unauthorized access and ensures the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive user information.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall enforce role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their role within the system.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Role-based access control minimizes the risk of unauthorized access and limits potential data breaches.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall log all access and modifications to critical data for auditability purposes.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Comprehensive logging provides an audit trail for accountability and enables investigation of security incidents.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall incorporate data anonymization techniques to protect user identities in logged data.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Data anonymization reduces privacy risks by ensuring that user identities cannot be easily re-identified from the data.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall conduct regular security audits at least bi-annually to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Regular security audits help maintain system integrity and protect against evolving security threats.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall implement a mechanism for secure remote software updates to protect against malware and ensure integrity.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Secure updates are essential for maintaining system integrity and protecting against exploitation of vulnerabilities.

TrustworthinessAgent.text: The system shall provide a user interface that informs users about data collection and consent requirements.
TrustworthinessAgent.rationale: Transparency in data collection fosters user trust and complies with privacy regulations.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This ensures adherence to regulatory safety and ethical guidelines for autonomous driving.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture that guarantees active monitoring and response to critical system failures.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This provides accountability and ensures that safety measures are in place to protect users.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds upon detecting a critical failure, ensuring safe stopping.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This minimizes potential harm to passengers and other road users during emergencies.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall continuously monitor and enforce compliance with its defined Operational Design Domain (ODD).
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This ensures the system operates within safe and permissible boundaries, promoting social responsibility.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall provide timely HMI warnings to request human takeover whenever ODD compliance is at risk.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This enhances accountability by allowing human oversight in critical situations.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall prioritize passenger safety over comfort and speed during emergency maneuvers, relaxing smoothness constraints as necessary.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This ensures ethical decision-making in conflict scenarios between safety and efficiency.

ResponsibilityAgent.text: The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions and changes for accountability and regulatory purposes.
ResponsibilityAgent.rationale: This promotes transparency and accountability in the autonomous driving system's operations.
